question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which of the given figures is NOT possible?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15b2a3aed80c3e8ace9224db697c22620e11e32d6ba506883febc9621a269c4e.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86e3626066c5ac123a6113194334d5a2d4813258461178d1c1bf0dfa487d2895.png] 

2 and 4 is the opposite sides.

3 and 5 is the opposite sides.

6 and 8 is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

**Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32515d6aaf01ad5c9f134e1ae692a6e0a00ffae24bcacb8b22f91ba48d25de45.png] → **Can not be made, because 2 and 4 is the opposite sides.**

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5eb19fddd11f721776e9d3c9c4cd5359050ea88280299bc19d03c7319eaf24a.png] → Can be made.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a39949c75f7bfc7ca250c1eaf20fb415979b8052453cd725bff42975f9d8c83f.png] → Can be made.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a32a0ad7b98eeb4419a255beb10d3ed828f051d31ae25f1289f49bd4861c8999.png] → Can be made.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
